title: Guards and redaction: leak scan, redact, gate classes, operator ids
goal: the leak scan flags a short EC key body with a slash that a period, underscore or hyphen follows and passes a repository path with a long segment and a table row without key material; redact rewrites the host of a url the public root never names; a gate that names a token count or a code identifier is classed by its other words while an API token stays secrets; kbwho gives no id for an alias that breaks the operator id rule and never overwrites an operators file it cannot parse; census apply refuses a leak in a new source row; runner watch signals only a process whose program is claude
